sentences.en: Lungs, heart, veins, arteries and capillaries form the cardiovascular system.
sentences.zh: 肺、心脏、静脉、动脉和毛细血管构成了心血管系统。

sentences.en: Sometimes the first symptom of cardiovascular disease is death.
sentences.zh: 有时，心血管疾病的首个症状就是死亡。

sentences.en: Cardiovascular endurance is one of the six components of physical fitness.
sentences.zh: 心肺耐力是体能的六个组成部分之一。
